exposure: birthweight of the first vaginally born baby
birthweight of the largest vaginally born baby
cohort: The study included 1125 women who had undergone at least two vaginal deliveries.
finding: The birthweight of the first vaginally born baby was significantly associated with levator ani muscle avulsion and significant pelvic organ prolapse.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between July 2014 and July 2017
